en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square with several multi‑story historic buildings. On the right, a corner building carries large German shop signs, including a confectionery advertising Baumkuchen, and next to it is a taller building with an external stair and a clock‑tower cupola on the roof. In the background stand more traditional townhouses enclosing the square and a central fountain or monument; a few pedestrians walk across the open square.
